# Velair 1.9.0-beta.6

## ✨ Added

- **Room groups** let several climates in the same room share one schedule, Mode/Profile configuration, boosts, pauses, Room Assist and Adaptive Preconditioning decision and learning history. Choose a member temperature reference and send commands to all members or a selected recipient when the installation already propagates commands. Members remain individually visible in Overview and Diagnostics and keep their own Comfort sensors and thresholds. Thanks to **@adri123** for [issue #55](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/55). See the [Room groups guide](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/blob/v1.9.0-beta.6/docs/user/room-groups.md).
- The new group editor uses Velair's existing list/detail interface, with searchable member selection, configurable ordering and a review dialog before adopting shared settings. Next events and Today's timeline show individual climates with their group underneath; event names open the shared programming. Existing dashboard cards preserve individual member filters, refresh shared inputs and respect the group's common temperature limits. Climate cards show compact group context on a third header line, with shared-action help and included members; the default-on Show group option can hide this context.
- **Live status** in Supply control shows room readings, effective targets, hysteresis boundaries, demand, switch state and pending waits in a read-only monitor that updates while open. Each climate occupies its own full-width row in a compact dialog, with height adjusted to its content.
- **Supply live-status dashboard card** brings the same monitor to dashboards. Select an existing supply and independently show or hide the header, live indicator, switch state, room-demand count, legend and routine demand description. Important status messages remain visible.
- **Lower/upper reference selection** enables Room Assist, Adaptive Preconditioning and Planned Return for dual-setpoint Heat and Cool devices. Room Assist shifts the full range together. Auto ranges continue to receive nominal scheduled targets without advanced thermal control. This adds advanced control to the scheduling compatibility introduced for **@Glooob-domo** in [issue #51](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/51).
- **Switch-on delay** in Supply control confirms sustained demand before activation. It overlaps minimum-off protection rather than adding another wait; status shows the limiting delay.
- **External switch-off notifications** explain why supply control paused and how to resume, through a persistent notification and Activity entry. Repeated notices remain bounded per supply. Manual-off suspension itself was already available in beta.5.
- **Automatic dashboard-resource management** maintains Velair's optional dashboard resource when Home Assistant manages resources through the interface, including recognized legacy local paths and duplicate entries. YAML-managed resources retain manual setup guidance. Thanks to **@LsHallo** for [issue #54](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/issues/54), which prompted this addition; the original report's cause has not been independently confirmed.

## 🔄 Changed

- Routine information about unverifiable measurement timestamps appears beside Comfort's sensor configuration rather than crowding Overview and cards. Missing, unavailable and stale-reading warnings remain visible.

## 🚀 Improved

- Supply control labels, help and guides consistently explain activation and deactivation hysteresis, with temperature and time units inside numeric fields.
- Updated interface and integration translations in all nine maintained languages, refreshed affected guides and added localized Room groups guidance covering control, Manual adjustment, learning and backup restoration.

## 🧭 Notes

- This beta follows [1.9.0-beta.5](https://github.com/cgonfer/velair/releases/tag/v1.9.0-beta.5) and adds room groups for validation before the stable release. Groups are internal Velair control units, not new Home Assistant entities.
- Review configuration adoption before saving: group control settings replace the members' independent settings. Pauses and Manual adjustment through a member apply to the shared room. An external change does not automatically copy that member's target to its peers.
- Group learning starts fresh. Membership, temperature-reference or command-delivery changes restart learning; renaming and reordering retain it. Removing members or dissolving a group preserves configuration copies but starts independent learning from zero. Back up configuration and include preconditioning learning before changing ownership.
- Portable exports use model version **25**. Older backups remain importable; older Velair versions cannot import model-25 exports. Keep a pre-update backup if you may downgrade.
- Translations are AI-assisted and do not claim qualified human linguistic review. Real-device propagation, native Home Assistant themes and Companion app behavior still need installation testing. See the guide's beta checklist when reporting results.
- After updating through HACS, restart Home Assistant and refresh the browser or Companion app. If the previous interface remains visible, perform a hard refresh or clear the site cache.
